Name: Stardew Enhanced Visuals
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
[b][color=#b45f06][size=6]Stardew Visual Enhancer[/size][/color][/b]
[heading][b][b][size=3]📖 Description & Purpose[/size][/b][/b][/heading]
[b][size=3][b]Stardew Visual Enhancer[/b] is an all-in-one visual transformation suite designed to modernize the look of Stardew Valley without sacrificing its charming pixel-art identity.
Instead of forcing players to search for, download, configure, and troubleshoot 5+ different visual mods and shader injectors, [b]Stardew Visual Enhancer unifies everything into a single seamless package[/b]:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=3][b]Native GPU Shader Pipeline:[/b] Multi-pass HDR bloom, filmic color grading, volumetric god rays, and dynamic day/night atmospheric transitions—[b]no ReShade or third-party injectors required![/b][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3][b]Dynamic Real-Time Lighting & Shadows:[/b] Living character shadows that react to the sun's position, soft building shadows, dynamic cloud shadows drifting across the farm, and swaying plant wind animations.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3][b]Realistic Water Simulation:[/b] High-definition animated waterflows, realistic foam, shorelines, and surface reflections.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3][b]Complete Architectural & Nature Redesign:[/b] Soft, natural building recolors (farmhouses, barns, coops, sheds) paired with lush seasonal trees, foliage, and handcrafted blended dirt/grass paths.[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=4]🌟 More From Me[/size][/b][/heading]
[size=2][b]📦 Pelican Trade Exchange — Build your own trading business with dynamic delivery contracts, 9 unique companies, reputation progression, changing demand, seasonal influences, and long-term contracts across the valley.
click here-> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51699]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51699[/url]
🎒 300 Slot Backpack — Expand your inventory to 300 slots with a scrollable interface and carry far more items while farming, mining, fishing, and exploring.
click here->[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51926]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51926[/url] [/b][/size]
[line]
[heading][b][b][size=4]✨ Main Features[/size][/b][/b][/heading]
[b][size=2][b]🌟 1. Native GPU Shaders & Atmospheric Post-Processing[/b][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=2][b]Multi-Pass HDR Bloom:[/b] Emits a natural, photographic glow from lanterns, windows, campfires, and streetlights.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]Filmic Color Grading:[/b] Eliminates the flat, harsh vanilla palette in favor of rich contrast, balanced saturation, and natural tones.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]Dynamic Time-of-Day Atmosphere:[/b] Smoothly shifts ambient lighting from the warm hues of sunrise, to bright midday sun, golden dusk, and cool, tranquil nights.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]Volumetric God Rays:[/b] Beams of sunlight pierce through open outdoor areas and tree canopies.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]Adaptive Screen Sharpening:[/b] Textures remain crystal-clear on 1080p, 1440p, and 4K displays.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]No Lens Blur:[/b] Edge blur / tilt-shift is permanently disabled for clean, edge-to-edge sharpness.[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][b][size=2][b]☀️ 2. Dynamic Real-Time Shadows & Reflections[/b][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=2][b]Player & NPC Shadows:[/b] Directional cast shadows that adjust angle and length based on in-game clock time.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]Canopy Lighting:[/b] Sunlight filters through tree leaves with subtle rim illumination.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]Living Flora:[/b] Plants, crops, and grass gently sway with realistic wind currents.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]Mirror Water Reflections:[/b] Characters, cliffs, and trees reflect gracefully across rivers, lakes, and oceans.[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][b][size=2][b]🏡 3. Complete Architectural, Nature & Path Overhaul[/b][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=2][b]Farm Buildings:[/b] Redrawn and softened textures for your Farmhouse, Barns, Coops, Sheds, Greenhouses, and Cabins.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]Flora & Trees:[/b] Seasonal foliage variants for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]Natural Paths & Tilesets:[/b] Hand-blended dirt pathways and grass borders that eliminate jarring tile edges.[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][b][size=2][b]🎛️ 4. In-Game Preset Controls & GMCM Support[/b][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=2][b]6 Built-in Presets:[/b] Switch instantly between [i]Cinematic[/i], [i]Vibrant[/i], [i]VanillaPlus[/i], [i]Natural[/i], [i]Dreamy[/i], and [i]NightEnhanced[/i].[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]Instant Toggle Key:[/b] Press
[/size][/b]
[code]F10[/code][b][size=2]anytime during gameplay to toggle shader effects on or off.[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b][b][size=2]📋 Requirements[/size][/b][/b][/heading]
[b][size=2]To run the complete suite, you only need standard Stardew Valley 1.6 modding frameworks:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][b][size=2][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url][/b] [i](version 4.0.0 or higher)[/i] — [b]Mandatory[/b][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/b] [i](version 2.0.0 or higher)[/i] — [b]Mandatory[/b] (used to load the integrated texture and water assets)[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url][/b] — [i]Optional / Recommended[/i] (allows you to change presets and tweak visual sliders directly from the in-game options menu).[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b][b][size=2]🛠️ Installation Instructions[/size][/b][/b][/heading]
[b][size=2]Installing the mod takes less than 30 seconds:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][b][size=2][b]Install Prerequisites:[/b]
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=2]Make sure you have installed [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b].[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]Download Stardew Visual Enhancer:[/b]
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=2]Download the latest
[/size][/b]
[code]StardewVisualEnhancer-1.0.0.zip[/code][b][size=2]from the [b]Files[/b] tab.[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]Extract into your Mods folder:[/b][/size][/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b][b][size=2]⚙️ Configuration & Controls[/size][/b][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][b][size=2][b]Hotkey:[/b] Press
[/size][/b]
[code]F10[/code][b][size=2]on your keyboard to instantly enable or disable shader effects.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][b]Configuration Menu:[/b] If you have [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] installed, click the gear icon on the main menu or in-game settings to customize:
[/size][/b]

[*][b][size=2]Dynamic shadow density and cloud shadows[/size][/b][/*]

[/list][/*]
[/list]
